source: Diaz-Banez et al. 2004 (Bridges); Wikipedia Palo (flamenco), canteytoque: soleá counted from beat 8; tempo a practice default

sources.title: El Compas Flamenco: A Phylogenetic Analysis (Diaz-Banez, Farigu, Gomez, Rappaport, Toussaint, Bridges 2004)
sources.shows: seguiriya as [x . x . x . . x . . x .] in 12 pulses: loud claps 1 3 5 8 11

sources.title: Palo (flamenco), Wikipedia
sources.shows: if you start counting the soleá on the eighth beat you obtain a seguiriya rhythm; soleá accents 3 6 8 10 12 from beat 8 give 1 3 5 8 11 (computed)

sources.shows: soleá accents 3 6 8 10 12; the seguiriya starts on beat 8 of that count
